geographic.evidence: Two inspected pictures support the slender red/white square lattice shaft, top platform/outriggers and paired guy cables. Retained tower node and heading23 degrees provide approximate location/facing. Standard viewer PMTiles working datum 134.05314223787755m supplies ground. Browser derivatives place the main slab at modelY.35 and each approximate guy block/cable endpoint on the same sampled grid. The preserved detailed master remains an archival instanced geometry source; the four browser derivatives supply terrain-fitted display. This round covers the main tall tower, not separate companion towers or the laboratory compound.
